items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The trial lasts 14 days and includes all Growth features. You do not need a credit card to start it.

items.q: Can I import contacts from a spreadsheet?
items.a: Yes. Upload a CSV file and map the columns once. Duplicates are flagged before anything is saved.
Yes. Send and track emails from inside a deal, and replies attach themselves to the right contact.

items.q: Can I change the pipeline stages?
items.a: Yes. Rename, add or remove stages to match your sales process. Existing deals keep their place.

items.q: How do follow up reminders work?
items.a: Every call, email or meeting sets a next step with a date. The day list shows what is due, in order.
Yes. Your workspace is separate from other teams, data is encrypted, and you can export everything at any time.
Yes. The interface is fully bilingual, Arabic and English, including right to left layout.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: You keep your data and move to the free Starter limits, or pick a paid plan. Nothing is deleted.
